primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-complexes-strong-effectiveness (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 5845-5851

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: for an inverse system (R_n) with locally nilpotent kernels and a compatible system of objects E_n (R_n-perfect, condition (2)), the Flatness on Spaces existence theorem produces a pseudo-coherent E on X_R with E_n its derived pullbacks compatibly; (R, Ker(R -> R_1)) is henselian (More on Algebra lemma) so the kernel lies in the Jacobson radical, and the henselian relatively-perfect lemma upgrades E to R-perfect; condition (2) holds because the negative-Ext vanishing locus is open (open lemma) and is true over V(Ker(R -> R_1)), which contains all points since the kernel is in the Jacobson radical (source lines 5853-5890)
